pullRequest.title: Expand README with endpoint table and examples
pullRequest.description: Docs-only change: converts the endpoint list to a table, adds curl examples, and documents the repo's purpose as an integration-testing sandbox.

summary.headline: Expands README documentation with endpoint table, curl examples, and purpose statement
summary.overview: This PR improves the README for the tps-demo Express application by restructuring the Endpoints section into a markdown table, adding a new Examples section with ready-to-run curl commands for /health and /echo, and introducing a Purpose section that clarifies the repository's role as a public sandbox for integration testing. No application code, dependencies, or API behavior are modified.

commits.message: Expand README with endpoint table, examples, and purpose
commits.author: WashingtonKK <washingtonkigan@gmail.com>

filesChanged.summary: Restructured endpoint documentation, added curl examples, and documented repository purpose

detailedChanges.description: Converted the Endpoints section from a markdown bullet list to a three-column table (Method, Path, Description) for clearer scanning of available API routes
Added a new Examples section with copy-paste curl commands: a GET request to /health and a POST request to /echo with JSON body and Content-Type header
Added a Purpose section explaining that the repository is a public sandbox for exercising integrations such as webhooks, CI checks, review bots, and pull-request workflows

behavioralChanges.before: Express server serves three endpoints with existing behavior
behavioralChanges.after: No change to application runtime behavior
behavioralChanges.details: index.js, package.json, and all API routes remain untouched. This is a documentation-only change.

behavioralChanges.before: README listed endpoints as bullets without usage examples or repo context
behavioralChanges.after: README provides a structured endpoint table, runnable curl examples, and a clear statement of the repository's integration-testing purpose
behavioralChanges.details: New contributors and integration consumers can discover endpoints faster and verify the server with provided curl commands.

verification.reason: Documentation-only change; no runtime verification required

items.mitigation: Keep README endpoint table in sync when adding or removing routes in index.js
Examples use localhost:3000 which matches the default PORT; users overriding PORT must adjust curl commands accordingly

recommendations: Consider adding a curl example for GET / to show the basic info response
If Docker support is added (see PR #7), include container-based run instructions alongside npm start
Add a link to the repository URL or integration setup guide if one exists for external consumers
